triage.summary: KubeSolo is unable to start pods because the image registry is unreachable, causing the apiserver to timeout and the kine datastore to fail.
triage.cause: The apiserver cannot connect to the kine (SQLite) datastore at 127.0.0.1:2379 due to a connection refused error, which indicates the kine is not responding. This is a common issue when the kine database is damaged or the datastore is unreachable.
